column1: # Rows db.oseed.* (line NP item DBO, 2026-11-20): BLASTP against tests/db_search/oseed (oseed_o, a stored O in two words AOA; oseed_x, the same with X) with the queries of tests/db_search/oseed_q.faa (README.md there): NCBI scans the stored bytes, so a query word AXA under the threshold finds the stored AXA and not the stored AOA, which it meets only as a neighbour (O scores as X).
